title: Customer Management
description: Learn how to manage customers, view customer profiles, and track customer activity in Tijraa.
content:
Customer Management

Managing customers effectively helps build relationships and improve customer satisfaction. This guide covers all aspects of customer management in Tijraa.

Viewing Customers

To view all customers:

  1. Navigate to Customers in the sidebar
  2. View customer list with key information
  3. Search and filter customers

Customer Profiles

Each customer profile includes:

  • Personal Information: Name, email, phone
  • Addresses: Billing and shipping addresses
  • Order History: All past orders
  • Account Status: Active or inactive
  • Registration Date: When they joined

Customer Addresses

Manage customer addresses:

  • View all saved addresses
  • Set default billing address
  • Set default shipping address
  • Edit or delete addresses

Order History

View customer's order history:

  • All past orders
  • Order status
  • Order totals
  • Order dates
  • Click to view order details

Searching Customers

Find customers quickly:

  • Search by name
  • Search by email
  • Search by phone
  • Filter by registration date
  • Filter by order count

Customer Segmentation

Organize customers:

  • Group by purchase behavior
  • Tag customers
  • Create customer segments
  • Target specific groups

Customer Communication

Communicate with customers:

  • View email history
  • Send order updates
  • Send promotional emails
  • Track communication

Customer Accounts

Activating Accounts

Manage account status:

  • Activate or deactivate accounts
  • Verify email addresses
  • Reset passwords

Account Permissions

Set customer permissions:

  • Order permissions
  • Access to order history
  • Account management rights

Customer Analytics

View customer analytics:

  • Total orders per customer
  • Total revenue per customer
  • Average order value
  • Purchase frequency
  • Customer lifetime value

Exporting Customer Data

Export customer information:

  • Export all customers
  • Export filtered customers
  • Export customer orders
  • Format: CSV or Excel

Customer Privacy

Respect customer privacy:

  • Comply with GDPR
  • Handle data securely
  • Allow data export
  • Allow account deletion

Next Steps

After managing customers:

  • Process customer orders
  • Configure shipping methods
meta_description: Complete guide to managing customers in Tijraa including profiles, addresses, order history, and customer analytics.
